'''Public Schinga Rentals''' was a location in the [[Thousand Thousand]], the most powerful [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], between the [[Schinga Tracks]] and the [[Beatific Razor Temple]]. The [[Schinga]] was a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Makem Te.<ref name="GatORW" />
